scope: Read, unread and flags match on every device.

topics.title: Marks in Yahoo Mail
details: A Yahoo account can now mark mail read or unread, and flag it. Press Q or X, as in Thunderbird.
A flag shows as a star in Yahoo Mail.
Opening a Yahoo message marks it read, as Yahoo Mail does.

topics.title: The same on every device
details: Read, unread and flags are kept on your mail server. Your phone and the web show the same marks.
A POP account keeps mail only on this computer. Companion tells you once that its marks stay here.
Importance is part of each message, so every device shows the same importance.

topics.title: Thunderbird
details: Thunderbird closes and opens again one time to get this change.
